responsibility: Provides the out-of-line method bodies for the full Rust HIR tree classes that are declared across the HIR headers but are too large or virtual to define inline. In practice this file implements debugging/stringification helpers such as many `as_string` renderers for crate, item, visibility, generic-parameter, and other HIR nodes, along with the broad set of `accept_vis` visitor-dispatch functions that connect concrete expression, pattern, statement, type, item, impl-item, and visibility-bearing nodes to the HIR visitor interfaces. Its role is therefore support behavior for the complete HIR object model—textual inspection and double-dispatch glue—rather than lowering, analysis, or dump traversal policy.
